info.name: Infoblox WAPI (Web API) DHCP DNS Zones API

params.name: _return_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the response. Use _return_fields+ to add fields to the default set.

params.name: _max_results
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. The default is 1000. Use a negative value to return all results.

params.name: fqdn
params.description: Filter by the fully qualified domain name of the zone.

params.name: view
params.description: Filter by the DNS view name.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of authoritative DNS zones. Supports filtering by FQDN, view, and zone format (forward or reverse).

info.name: Infoblox Create an authoritative DNS zone

items.docs: Creates a new authoritative DNS zone with the specified FQDN and zone format. The zone is created in the specified DNS view.

params.name: _return_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the response. Use _return_fields+ to add fields to the default set.

params.name: _max_results
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. The default is 1000. Use a negative value to return all results.

params.name: fqdn
params.description: Filter by the fully qualified domain name of the forward zone.

params.name: view
params.description: Filter by the DNS view name.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of forward DNS zones. A forward zone forwards queries to specified DNS servers rather than resolving them locally.
